purpose: Check the suspect Cheilopogon spilinopterus spelling in Morales et al. (2016) against the California Academy of Sciences Catalog of Fishes while preserving the original catch label and avoiding an unsupported species-level correction or occurrence.

limitations: The paper provides no specimen voucher or diagnostic basis for independently re-identifying this catch label in the reviewed text.
The same paper gives the common name Spotfin flyingfish to Cheilopogon furcatus and the local name Dibang to both the printed spilinopterus label and Cheilopogon nigricans.

candidateCrosswalk.interpretation: The indexed catalog distinguishes C. spilopterus and C. spilonotopterus as different valid names. C. spilopterus is a plausible orthographic candidate for the paper's printed label, but the catalog does not verify the paper's identification or the Batanes specimen. The exact source spelling was not directly resolved by a complete live catalog search in this pass.
